# Related Backblaze B2 sample applications

The [`backblaze-b2-samples`](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples) and [`backblaze-labs`](https://github.com/backblaze-labs) organizations publish applications that complement these reference architectures. Each project listed below shows a specific curation, training, generation, moderation, finishing or delivery pattern. A sample shows the B2 side of a workflow; it is not a third-party platform's built-in B2 option.

## Selection guidance

- Select a sample based on the required workflow and data formats.
- Keep key design, retention, provenance and compliance decisions in this repository's architecture documents.
- Use the architecture's manifest requirements for published datasets and provenance records.
- Configure authentication, tenant isolation, scoped credentials, retention, and recovery for the deployment.
